decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The rear dormer window hereby approved shall meet the following criteria unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority:
* be at least 1 metre away from the party wall with 12, Hamilton Road,
* shall not, in any way, project into the hip roof slope opposite 16, Hamilton Road,
* shall include a gap of at least 0.3 metres between the roof of the proposed dormer and the main roof ridge,
* shall include a gap of at least 0.5 metres between the bottom of the dormer and the bottom of the rear roof slope of the house.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, roof extension to the rear roof slope with a loft conversion to create habitable roof space to the house, following demolition of the existing rear conservatory
